description: Add a PodDisruptionBudget whose selector must match the Deployment's pod labels exactly and whose minAvailable must leave room for voluntary disruption
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml runs the payments-api Deployment (3 replicas) in the payments namespace. Add k8s/pdb.yaml with a policy/v1 PodDisruptionBudget named payments-api in the same namespace: its spec.selector.matchLabels must match the Deployment's pod template labels EXACTLY (not a subset, not extra labels - a mismatched selector protects zero pods), and minAvailable must be 2 (leaving room for exactly one voluntary disruption, e.g. a node drain, out of 3 replicas without an outage).

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payments-api
  namespace: payments
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payments-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: payments-api
        tier: backend
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: payments-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/payments-api:3.4.0

test_setup_files.check_pdb.py:
import yaml

with open("k8s/deployment.yaml") as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)
pod_labels = dep["spec"]["template"]["metadata"]["labels"]

with open("k8s/pdb.yaml") as f:
    pdb = yaml.safe_load(f)

assert pdb["apiVersion"] == "policy/v1" and pdb["kind"] == "PodDisruptionBudget", (
    f"expected a policy/v1 PodDisruptionBudget, got {pdb.get('apiVersion')}/{pdb.get('kind')}")
assert pdb["metadata"].get("namespace") == "payments", "PDB must live in the payments namespace"

selector = (pdb["spec"].get("selector") or {}).get("matchLabels") or {}
assert selector == pod_labels, (
    f"PDB selector {selector} must match the Deployment's pod labels {pod_labels} exactly - "
    f"a mismatched selector protects zero pods")

assert pdb["spec"].get("minAvailable") == 2, (
    f"expected minAvailable 2, got {pdb['spec'].get('minAvailable')}")

print("PASS pdb structural checks")

reference_solution.k8s/pdb.yaml:
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: payments-api
  namespace: payments
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payments-api
      tier: backend
